summary: Prepare commodity supply chains for EUDR with practical mapping, plot-data checks, and due-diligence exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: EUDR readiness training helps commodity supply-chain teams assemble traceable evidence for covered products. It is designed for exporters, processors, cooperative managers and traceability leads who need to map suppliers and plots, validate geolocation and batch records, and document legality and deforestation-risk reviews. Practical work includes QGIS mapping, data-quality checks, supplier coordination, and organizing due-diligence records and mitigation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for EUDR evidence, commodity sourcing, geospatial data, supplier readiness, or market-access support.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commodity procurement, export documentation, cooperative operations, or supply-chain records is recommended. No programming is required. For hands-on mapping and data exercises, bring a laptop with QGIS installed and access to Microsoft Excel; the course does not require access to the live EU Information System.
